question: A certain sum is deposited for 4 years at a rate of 10% per annum on compound interest compounded annually. The difference between the interest at the end of 2 years and that at the end of 4 years is Rs. 5,082. Find the sum (in Rs.).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

We know, successive interest of a% and b% = [a + b + ab/100]%

The successive interest for 2 years = [10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100]% = 21%

The successive interest for 3 years = [21 + 10 + (21 × 10)/100]% = 33.1%

The successive interest for 4 years = [33.1 + 10 + (33.1 × 10)/100]% = 46.41%

The difference of interest between 4 and 2 years = 46.41 - 21 = 25.41%

So, 25.41% → 5082

Then, 100% → (5082/25.41) × 100 = 20000

∴ The sum (in Rs.) is Rs. 20000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A certain sum is deposited for 4 years at a rate of 10% per annum on compound interest compounded annually.

Formula used:

At compound interest, the final amount = P(1+(r)/(100) )^n-P

Where, P = The sum of the amount

r = Rate of interest

n = Time (years)

**Calculation:**

Let, the sum of amount = x

[x(1+(10)/(100) )⁴-x]-[x(1+(10)/(100) )²-x] = 5082

⇒ [x((11)/(10) )⁴-x]-[x((11)/(10) )²-x] = 5082

⇒ (14641x)/(10000) - x - (121x)/(100) + x = 5082

⇒ 14641x/10000 - 121x/100 = 5082

⇒ 2541x/10000 = 5082

⇒ x = 5082 × (10000/2541) = 20000

**∴ The sum (in Rs.) is Rs. 20000**
